changelog:
AudienceLab's complete ad copywriting framework released.

- Create full customer avatars for every stage of awareness using detailed templates.
- Diary Entry Method unlocks authentic, emotional ad copy in the voice of the target customer.
- Step-by-step ad architecture: Interrupt, Engage, Educate, Offer, with six distinct hook types.
- Multiple legendary copywriting styles (Gary Halbert, Dan Kennedy, etc.) for quick ad variations.
- Built-in headlines & hooks generator with proven attention-grabbing examples and formulas.
- Versatile system for ad scripts, emails, landing pages, and more—usable across any niche.
summary: AudienceLab ad copywriting system. Complete framework for creating high-converting ad scripts, headlines, and hooks. Use when writing ad copy for YourAgency...
